At this week’s Mishmar we heard from our very own Rabbi Yaakov Tessler, who opened up about some of the personal challenges he’s faced- from losing his habruta in a shooting in his Yeshivah which caused him to develop a stutter, to being there during the Gush Katif evacuation. He taught us how to get through life’s challenges through the lens of Torah.

Mishmar was graciously sponsored by alumni Alan Mehani, Joey Sutton, Sam Cohen and Jack Gani

*Ahabat Eres Yisrael Program is graciously sponsored in honor of our parents Ezra & Sharyn Ashkenazi by their children* 

Today we hiked Arbel, a trail next to the Kineret. On our way down we stopped to see the caves that the Jews were forced to use when hiding from the Romans. After completing the hike we got to cool off in the Kineret and enjoy “AQUA Kef”, Israel’s largest floating water park!
MarHeshvan month of learning is generously sponsored by The Betesh Family

*Rosh Hodesh Series 5787 is graciously sponsored in memory of Karen Mizrahi A”H*

At this mornings MarHeshvan special breakfast we heard Dibre Torah from Rabbi Gold, Josh Aboody & Moshe Alouf

*Mishmar Series 5787 is graciously sponsored in memory of Raymond Mosseri A”H רחמים בן מזל by The Mosseri Family*

At this week’s Mishmar we heard from our very own Rabbi Edward Benjamin! He spoke to us about staying true to the Torah and how we should maximize every minute of this year.

Mishmar was graciously sponsored by alumni Morris Hanan

To celebrate the start of a new semester we had a barbecue in Gan Saker this afternoon- just another perk of our amazing location. There’s nothing like being in Jerusalem, having this park as our backyard!
